echava: echar — he was lying down, throwing himself (imperfect 3rd sg., -ava; echarse 'to lie down'; i se echava 'he lay down there'; = echaba)

adurmió: adormir(se) — he fell asleep (preterite 3rd sg., reflexive se adurmió; = se durmió, closest se adormeció)
visión: visión — vision, dream-vision (= visión; en visión 'in a vision')
cavalgad: cavalgar — ride! (2nd pl. imperative, polite plural to a single person; = cabalgad)
punto: punto — moment, point of time, hour (en tan buen punto 'at so good a moment'; = punto, closest hora/ocasión)
varón: varón — man, male, man of worth (= varón)

despertó: despertar — he woke up (preterite 3rd sg.; = despertó)

sinava: sinar — he was signing, making the cross on (imperfect 3rd sg.; Latin signare; sinar la cara 'to cross one's face'; = signaba, closest persignaba)

sueño: sueño — dream; also sleep (= sueño; del sueño que soñado a 'of the dream he has dreamed')

ivan: ir — they were going (imperfect 3rd pl.; ivan posar 'they were going to lodge'; = iban)
diestro: diestro — right (hand, side), noun use (de diestro 'on the right'; = diestro, closest derecha)
atiença: Atiença — Atienza, fortified town in Guadalajara province (= Atienza; traditional identification)
puesto: poner — set (past part.; non era puesto el sol 'the sun had not set'; = puesto)
peonadas: peonada — company of foot-soldiers (collective from peón; = peonada, which in modern Spanish means a group of laborers or a day's labor)
notó: notar — he noted, counted (preterite 3rd sg.; = notó, closest contó)
trezientas: trezientos — three hundred (fem. pl., agreeing with lanças; = trescientas)
lanças: lança — lance; also the horseman who bears it (pl.; = lanzas)

sí: sí — so, thus (optative particle, Latin sic; sí el Criador vos salue 'so may the Creator save you'; = así, no modern use as a particle)

cavalgue: cavalgar — let him ride (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; = cabalgue)
passaremos: passar — we shall cross, pass (future 1st pl.; = pasaremos)
fiera: fiero — fierce, rugged, wild (fem.; la sierra que fiera es 'the mountains, which are rugged'; = fiera, which in modern Spanish is a noun, 'wild beast'; the adjective is fiero)
alfonso: Alfonso — King Alfonso (VI of León and Castile), the Cid's lord (= Alfonso)
podemos: poder — we can, are able (present 1st pl.; = podemos)
buscare: buscar — shall seek (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; qui nos buscare 'whoever shall seek us'; = buscare, tense obsolete)
podrá: poder — he will be able (future 3rd sg.; = podrá)
passan: passar — they cross, pass (present 3rd pl.; = pasan)
vinida: venir — come, arrived (fem. past part. vinida; vinida es la man 'morning has come', ser as auxiliary of an intransitive; = venida)
loma: loma — ridge, long low hill, hillside (= loma)
fizo: fazer — he made, did, caused (strong preterite 3rd sg.; fizo posar 'he made (them) halt'; = hizo)
díxoles: dezir + les — he said to them (preterite dixo + enclitic dative les; = les dijo)
trasnochar: trasnochar — to travel through the night, go without sleep (infinitive; = trasnochar 'to stay up all night')
anochesca: anochecer — night falls (present subjunctive 3rd sg., -sc- stem; ante que anochesca 'before night falls'; = anochezca)
tal: tal — such; por tal 'for such a reason, for this purpose' (= tal)
ventasse: ventar — should scent, detect (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., -asse; que no lo ventasse nadi 'that no one should get wind of it'; = ventease, closest ventear, 'to sniff out')
andidieron: andar — they travelled, marched (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = anduvieron)
dan: dar — they give (present 3rd pl.; vagar non se dan 'they allow themselves no leisure'; = dan)
castejón: Castejón — Castejón, a town taken by the Cid, traditionally Castejón de Henares (Guadalajara province); not the modern Navarrese Castejón
fenares: Fenares — the river Henares (f- for h-; = Henares)
echó: echar — he threw, cast (preterite 3rd sg.; echarse en çelada 'to lie in ambush'; = echó)
çelada: çelada — ambush (en çelada 'in ambush'; sacar a çelada 'to draw out into an ambush'; = celada, 'ambush, trap')
aquellos: aquel — those (masc. pl. demonstrative; con aquellos que 'with those who'; = aquellos)
consejava: consejar — he advised (imperfect 3rd sg.; commo los consejava 'as he advised them'; = aconsejaba)
álbar: Álbar — Álvar (personal name, Álbar Fáñez; = Álvar)
aquesta: aquesta — this (fem. sg., reinforced demonstrative; = esta, archaic aquesta)
sacaremos: sacar — we shall draw out (future 1st pl.; sacar a çelada 'to lure out into ambush'; = sacaremos)
teniendo: tener — holding (gerund; teniendo a la çaga 'holding the rearguard'; = teniendo)
çaga: çaga — rear, rearguard (a la çaga 'at the rear'; = zaga)
algara: algara — raid, foray, raiding party (Arabic al-gāra; ir en algara 'to go on a raid'; = algara, a learned word)
auze: auze — word of uncertain sense, probably 'help, good fortune' (vuestra auze; unattested elsewhere; no modern equivalent; uncertain)
feremos: fazer — we shall make, win (future 1st pl., syncopated; feremos ganançia 'we shall make gain'; = haremos)
id: ir — go! (2nd pl. imperative; id vos 'go (you)', with reflexive vos; = id, idos)
vaya: ir — let him go (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; = vaya)
salvadórez: Salvadórez — patronymic 'son of Salvador' (modern cognate Salvadores)
falla: falla — failure, lack (noun; sin falla 'without fail'; = falla, closest falta)
garciaz: Garciaz — patronymic 'son of García' (modern cognate Garcés)
fardida: fardido — bold, valiant (fem.; fardida lança 'bold lance', i.e. a bold warrior; a form of ardido with prothetic f-; no modern equivalent, closest ardido, audaz)
acompañen: acompañar — may they accompany (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = acompañen)
aosadas: aosadas — boldly, resolutely (adverb from a osadas; = a osadas, archaic; closest osadamente)
corred: correr — run!, ride!, raid! (2nd pl. imperative; correr 'to overrun, raid'; = corred)
dexedes: dexar — you leave, may you leave (present subjunctive 2nd pl., prohibition; non dexedes nada 'leave nothing'; = dejéis)
fita: Fita — Hita, town in Guadalajara province (f- for h-; = Hita; traditional identification)
guadalfajara: Guadalfajara — Guadalajara, city on the Henares (Arabic wādī al-ḥijāra 'river of stones'; = Guadalajara)
fata: fata — until, as far as (variant of fasta; = hasta)
alcalá: Alcalá — Alcalá de Henares (traditional identification; Arabic al-qalʿa 'the castle'; = Alcalá de Henares)
lleguen: llegar — may they arrive, reach (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = lleguen)
acojan: acoger — may they gather in, collect (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; acojan ganançias 'let them collect the spoils'; = acojan, but modern acoger means 'to welcome, shelter')
dexen: dexar — may they leave (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = dejen)
fincaré: fincar — I shall remain (future 1st sg.; = quedaré, closest; modern hincar means 'to drive in')
terné: tener — I shall hold (future 1st sg., syncopated; = tendré)
abremos: aver — we shall have (future 1st pl., syncopated; = habremos)
enpara: enpara — protection, defence, refuge (noun, from amparar; = amparo)
cueta: cueta — distress, trouble, urgent need (= cuita, 'grief, trouble'; closest apuro)
fazedme: fazer + me — do for me (2nd pl. imperative fazed + enclitic me; fazedme mandado 'send me word'; = hacedme)
acorro: acorro — help, succour (noun, from acorrer 'to run to help'; no modern noun, closest socorro)
nombrados: nombrar — named, appointed (past part. masc. pl.; = nombrados)
irán: ir — they will go (future 3rd pl.; = irán)
fincarán: fincar — they will remain (future 3rd pl.; = quedarán, closest)
crieban: crebar — they were breaking (imperfect 3rd pl.; ya crieban los albores 'dawn was breaking'; Pidal's restoration of the diphthongized stem; = quebraban, modern quebrar; uncertain form)
vinie: venir — it came (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; vinie la mañana 'morning came'; = venía)
ixie: exir — it was rising, going out (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; ixie el sol 'the sun was rising'; = salía; no modern exir)
apuntava: apuntar — it was appearing, dawning (imperfect 3rd sg.; qué fermoso apuntava 'how fair it broke'; = apuntaba)
levantavan: levantar(se) — they were rising, getting up (imperfect 3rd pl.; = levantaban)
fuera: fuera — outside, out of doors (adverb; de fuera 'outside, from outside'; = fuera)
davan: dar — they were giving (imperfect 3rd pl.; salto davan 'they made a dash'; = daban)
ver: ver — to see (infinitive; por ver 'in order to see, to look to'; = ver)
lavores: lavor — work, labor; here worked fields (pl.; = labores)
heredanças: heredança — inherited estate, landholding (pl.; = herencias, heredades; closest heredades)
exidos: exir — gone out (past part. masc. pl.; son exidos 'have gone out', ser as auxiliary; = salidos)
dexadas: dexar — left (past part. fem. pl.; las puertas an dexadas 'they have left the gates'; = dejadas)
pocas: poco — few (fem. pl.; pocas de gentes 'few people'; = pocas)
fincaran: fincar — they remained (-aran, Latin pluperfect used as a preterite, 3rd pl.; Pidal's fincar[a]n; = quedaron; sense 'had remained' also possible)
derramadas: derramar — scattered, dispersed (past part. fem. pl.; son derramadas 'are scattered'; = derramadas, closest dispersas)
corríe: correr — he was running, raiding (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; corríe a Castejón 'he overran Castejón'; = corría)
avienlos: aver + los — they had them, got them (imperfect 3rd pl. avién + enclitic los; aver de ganançia 'to get as booty'; = los habían)
andan: andar — they go about, range (present 3rd pl.; = andan)
rodrigo: Rodrigo — Rodrigo, the Cid's given name (= Rodrigo)
adeliñava: adeliñar — he was making straight for (imperfect 3rd sg.; = adeliñaba; no modern equivalent, closest dirigirse a)
vidieron: veer — they saw (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = vieron)
rebata: rebata — sudden alarm, surprise attack (= rebato)
desenparada: desenparar — abandoned, left defenceless (past part. fem.; fo desenparada 'was abandoned', passive; = desamparada)
ruy: Ruy — Ruy, short form of Rodrigo (= Ruy)
desnuda: desnudo — bare, drawn (fem.; espada desnuda 'drawn sword'; = desnuda)
matava: matar — he was killing (imperfect 3rd sg.; = mataba)
alcançava: alcançar — he was overtaking, catching (imperfect 3rd sg.; = alcanzaba)
gañó: gañar — he won, captured (preterite 3rd sg.; = ganó)
ela: ela — the (fem. article, apparently a fused form; ela plata 'the silver'; = la; the analysis, perhaps e + la, is uncertain)
déxanla: dexar + la — they leave her/it (present dexan + enclitic la; = la dejan)
preçia: preçiar — he values, reckons (present 3rd sg.; non preçia nada 'he counts it as nothing'; = aprecia, precia)
corren: correr — they run, raid (present 3rd pl.; = corren)
preavan: preár — they were plundering (imperfect 3rd pl., from prea 'booty'; = preaban; no modern verb, closest depredar, saquear)
seña: seña — banner, standard (= seña; modern seña is 'sign', the banner sense is enseña)
desí: desí — then, thereupon (adverb, de + sí/así; no modern equivalent, closest después, luego)
tórnanse: tornar + se — they turn back, return (present tornan + enclitic se; = se tornan, closest vuelven)
largas: largo — abundant, generous (fem. pl.; riquizas largas 'abundant riches'; = largas)
derecha: derecho — straight (fem.; derecha viene 'comes straight on'; = derecha, closest directamente)
fellos: afé + los — behold them (presentative, as afevos with los; = helos aquí, he aquí)
saliólos: salir + los — he went out to (them) (preterite salió + enclitic los; saliólos reçebir 'went out to welcome them'; = salió a recibirlos)
mesnada: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (= mesnada)
reçibe: reçebir — he welcomes, receives (present 3rd sg.; = recibe)
albarfáñez: Albarfáñez — Álvar Fáñez written as one word (= Álvar Fáñez)
enbiás: enbiar — I should send (imperfect subjunctive, apocopated -ás for -asse; do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; = enviase; the person and tense analysis is uncertain)
abría: aver — I would have (conditional 1st sg., syncopated; bien abría tal esperança 'I would have such hope'; = habría)
esso: esso — that (neuter demonstrative; esso con esto 'that together with this'; = eso)
ajuntado: ajuntar — joined, added (past part.; sea ajuntado 'let it be added'; = juntado, ajuntar is regional)
quinta: quinta — fifth, the fifth part of the booty, the lord's share (= quinta; legal quinto, 'a fifth')
quisiéredes: querer — you shall wish (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; si la quisiéredes 'if you wish it'; = quisiereis, tense obsolete)

__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que)
__broaden__.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned')
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro)
__broaden__.el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara)
__broaden__.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate')
__broaden__.él: él — he (stressed subject pronoun) · also él — 'him, it' after a preposition, of a thing (a él vino; en él fincaredes 'in it', i.e. in Castejón)
__broaden__.lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
__broaden__.son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
__broaden__.sin: sin — without · also sin — 'besides, apart from' (sin las peonadas 'besides the foot-soldiers'); sin falla 'without fail'; sin dubda
__broaden__.vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
__broaden__.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly'
__broaden__.dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos) · also dar salto 'to make a dash, sally' (salto davan); dar çevada 'to give barley, feed the horses'
__broaden__.salto: salto — leap, jump · also dash, sally (dar salto 'to make a sortie'; non osa ninguno dar salto a la çaga 'none dares to dash at the rearguard')
__broaden__.querié: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; la noch querié entrar 'night was about to fall'; = quería) · also querer — he wished (imperfect 3rd sg.; commo querié trasnochar 'how he wished to travel by night'; = quería)
__broaden__.coraçón: coraçón — heart (= corazón) · also por coraçón 'willingly, heartily, with a will' (lo an por coraçón)
__broaden__.mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word'
__broaden__.faze: fazer — is done, is made (present 3rd sg.; = hace) · also fazer — he does, makes (active present 3rd sg.; por tal lo faze mio Çid 'for that reason Mio Cid does it'; = hace)
__broaden__.o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde)
__broaden__.los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them')
__broaden__.arriba: arriba — up, upward (adverb; = arriba) · also postposed 'up, upstream' (Fenares arriba 'up the Henares'; desí arriba 'from there upward')
__broaden__.castiello: castiello — castle (= castillo; here the castle quarter of Burgos) · also the castle of Castejón (el castiello dexó en so poder)
__broaden__.poder: poder — to be able (infinitive; first half of a split future, poder nos han alcançar 'they will be able to overtake us'; = poder) · also poder — power, hands, control (noun; en so poder 'in his keeping'; = poder)
__broaden__.do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain)
